title: Stand-up comedy routine about Spreadsheets
summary: Matt Parker's stand-up routine about spreadsheets, taken from the Festival of the Spoken Nerd DVD Full Frontal Nerdity. It features Excel used in unexpected ways, including turning an image into a spreadsheet.
why: HN recommends it as a funny piece on Excel used in ways it shouldn't be.
